exposure: Chosen doctor in the public system
Chosen midwife in the public system
Model of care (public insurance, chosen doctor in public system, chosen midwife in public system, private midwife-led community birth)
finding: Hungarian women who planned to give birth in the community with a private midwife had significantly lower rates of cesarean section, induced labor, episiotomy, and disrespectful care, and higher levels of autonomy, compared to women who planned to give birth in other settings.
